spec: 12 §6.1 (callback contract), 12 §6.2 (cascade queue, breadth-first FIFO, delivery order), 12 §6.3 (cascade budget), 12 §6.4 (plugin and feed snapshot timing), 12 §4.2 (event_clock, decision stamp), 12 §5.3, 12 §9.1 (ledger applied at delivery), 30 §4 rules 5–8, 30 §4.1 (interests), 22 §3.3 (ordering contract)
notes: Each vector is a scripted strategy for the testkit (30 §15): `script` says what the strategy does in which callback; `expect` is the required observable (callback sequence, portfolio view inside a callback, trace record order, diagnostics).

Callback sequences are written as (event kind, cid). Where the exact per-order sequence depends on the profile (13 §5.1 vs 13 §6.7) the expectation is an ORDER INVARIANT that holds in both profiles rather than a literal list.

The breadth-first rule (12 §6.2): intents written in the callback for event k are handled immediately and their events are appended to the BACK of the FIFO queue; everything already queued is delivered first.

vectors.script: on_tick (first in-window tick): place A = GTC BUY UP @ bid-0.01 size 5 cid a, B = GTC BUY DOWN @ bid-0.01 size 5 cid b (two place intents in one callback). on_event(OrderSubmitted a): place C = GTC BUY UP @ bid-0.02 size 5 cid c. No other intents.

expect.invariant: every event of C is delivered after every event of A and B that was already in the queue when the OrderSubmitted(a) callback ran; in ts-compat (synchronous events, delay 0) the delivered sequence is exactly [sub a, acc a, su a, open a, sub b, acc b, su b, open b, sub c, acc c, su c, open c]
expect.realistic_invariant: [sub a, sub b] are delivered in the tick's drain before sub c; later exchange reports of a and b (arrival + L_ack) are delivered before those of c because c is submitted later and latencies are constant

vectors.script: as cs-01, plus on_event(OrderOpen c): cancel a.

expect.invariant: the cancel's events (ts-compat: order_done(a, canceled); realistic: cancel_acked / order_done) come after every event of c that was queued before the OrderOpen(c) callback; the cancel intent is traced right after the Decision record of the OrderOpen(c) callback (22 §3.3)

vectors.spec: 12 §6.2 (ledger -> OM -> trace -> strategy -> trace Decision -> OM), 12 §9.1, 12 §9.2
vectors.script: place A = GTC BUY UP 5 @ 0.50 (resting); later a tick fills it as maker; record portfolio() inside each callback.

expect.in_order_submitted_callback: portfolio().open_orders() contains a; order(a).state == InFlight; capital().reserved == reservation(a) (12 §9.4: reservation exists from decision time; 12 §9.2 OrderSubmitted sets submitted_delivered)
expect.in_fill_callback: position(Up).qty == 5; order(a).filled == 5; order(a).remaining == 0 (ledger applied before the callback)
expect.in_order_done_callback: order(a).state == Filled; capital().reserved == 0; open_orders() does not contain a

vectors.spec: 12 §6.1 (every delivered event is offered, incl. OrderSubmitted and every SettlementUpdate), 30 §4.1
vectors.script: interests = all (default). Place one FOK BUY that fills. Count callbacks by kind.

expect.invariant: number of on_event callbacks == number of `event` records in the parity trace (22 §3.2: both write every kind delivered to the strategy)

vectors.script: same as cs-04 but interests omit LIFECYCLE (OrderSubmitted, OrderAccepted, OrderDelayed, OrderOpen, CancelAcked, OrderDone).

expect.callbacks: only fill and settlement_update callbacks run
expect.unchanged: MarketStats, resultDigest, the parity trace and the final portfolio are byte-identical to cs-04 (the trace still records every delivered event)
expect.note: see PLAN.md ambiguity A-07 on whether a skipped-by-interest event counts as delivered for 22 §3.3

vectors.script: on_tick: place GTC BUY UP @ bid-0.01 size 1 cid r0. on_event(OrderSubmitted r{n}): place cid r{n+1} (same price/size). Unbounded cascade.

expect.note: TS clears the queue silently and continues; not reproduced (12 §6.3). Threshold semantics (> vs >= maxEventsPerDrain) is PLAN.md ambiguity A-08.

vectors.script: ticks at start+1000 (t0), start+2000 (t1), start+3000 (t2). on_tick at t1: place FOK BUY UP at best ask size 1 (fills synchronously in ts-compat with delay 0). Read event_clock() in every callback.

expect.at_t0_tick: event_clock() == t0 (set by the first dispatched strategy tick)
expect.at_t1_tick_before_intents: event_clock() == t0 (ticks do not advance it)
expect.in_account_callbacks_of_t1: event_clock() == t1 (max over delivered account event timestamps)

vectors.spec: 12 §4.2 (decision stamp), 13 TC-C8, 11 §4 (GTD check uses the stamp)
vectors.script: tick at T. on_tick: place GTC BUY UP (resting). on_event(OrderOpen): place GTD BUY UP with expire_at = T + 60000 cid g1 and GTD with expire_at = T + 59999 cid g2.

expect.g2: OrderRejected(GtdExpiryTooSoon{min_offset_ms: 60000}) — the callback intents are stamped with the last tick's ts T, not with a later time

vectors.script: resting GTC at the window end; ticks continue after end in the input.

expect.ts_compat: no on_tick and no on_event after the last in-window tick (tick.ts <= end inclusive); the order stays open in the final view; no OrderDone at end (TC-C13)
expect.realistic: no strategy callback with now >= end; the engine's CancelMarket(WindowEnd) at end and the MarketClosed cancel are applied to the ledger without callbacks; final view shows the order terminal (Canceled(WindowEnd) or Canceled(MarketClosed))

vectors.spec: 12 §6.4, 12 §5.2 (callbacks see the new book and the previous snapshot), 14 P-4
vectors.requires: a plugin (DwellGate or TimeWindowVolatility, 14) — G2 scope only if the testkit exposes plugins; else outlined
vectors.script: request DwellGate; place a resting order at tick N-1; tick N changes the book so that the order fills (maker) and the plugin output changes.

expect.in_fill_callback_of_tick_N: ctx.book() shows tick N's book; ctx.plugins() equals the snapshot built at tick N-1; ctx.tick().seq == N-1 is NOT required (tick() is the last dispatched tick: N-1 until tick N's own callback runs) — see PLAN.md A-09

vectors.spec: 12 §5.3 (synthetic ticks never run the execution step), 14 F-36
vectors.requires: binance_spot with tick_on_update (14); G2 scope if the testkit scripts feed updates (30 §15 lists feed updates)
vectors.script: resting GTC BUY @ P; a feed update arrives while the recorded best ask is already < P without a new book event.
vectors.expect: no fill on the synthetic tick; the fill happens on the next real book/price_change tick

vectors.script: strategy with a counter in its state; run two markets in one process (group or sequential).
vectors.expect: the counter starts at 0 in each market; Strategy::new is called once per (candidate, market)

vectors.spec: 12 §6.1 (the engine's own OrderSubmitted), 60 §5.4 A1 (intent from an engine-synthesized event)
vectors.script: on_event(OrderSubmitted x11): place x11-sib at x11 price - 0.01; on_event(OrderOpen x11-sib): cancel x11.
vectors.expect: both callbacks run; x11-sib's OrderSubmitted appears after x11's remaining queued events; the cancel of x11 is processed after x11-sib's queued events (cs-02)
